comparison.objective: Remove and contain four insert tangs; record uniformly heat-shrinks a cable sleeve.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate needs precision mandrel alignment, hammering, and fragment search; record coordinates cable rotation with noncontact heat-gun motion and exposure control.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contained fractures and no damage; record requires all sleeve stations recovered, adhesive at both ends, no charring/contact, and gun safely stowed. Candidate quantitative damage limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Controlled thermal exposure over time is unrelated to mechanical notch fracture beyond generic bimanual tool use.
